d: Real Madrid have returned to winning ways under Jose Mourinho, putting together seven consecutive victories across competitions. Their dramatic Champions League win against AEK Athens extended that run, but the performance also brought renewed attention to Vinicius Junior and his role in the team's attacking structure. With Yan Diomande offering a different option on the wings, questions about Real Madrid's balance, defensive contribution and attacking combinations have become part of the conversation.
